lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Semi-regular grid of high-luminance circular clusters organized in roughly parallel longitudinal rows posterior to the five gill slits.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersecting the horizontal rows of blobs, creating a faint grid-like pattern immediately posterior to the gills.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Two distinct horizontal linear features on the upper flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient with highlights on the superior edge and shadowing on the inferior edge.
